· Position vs SMA100/200 ($68.95/$64.27): maintaining medium-to-long-term trend strength.

[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (44.3→49.7) + neutral assessment + gradual recovery.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.2065→-0.0713) + improving assessment + no confirmation of bearish reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $70.70) + band width at 5.99% indicating contraction.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($69.48) + basis (based on moving averages).
· Swing resistance ($71.84) + potential for upward reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (consolidation) + lack of directional trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.85x) + reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase assessment (accumulation) + conditions for entry: confirmation of RSI holding above 50 and ADX exceeding 20.
